description: What Pebble's windows draw: the work view (each activity item's view, the reply's header and summary) and the native kinds of UIRender. Data only; renderers own the design. Render by type, ignore unknown fields, and show an unknown type as its item's label and detail ("Update the app to see this view" on the iPhone).
